controls.positive: A fantasy tavern chalkboard menu hanging on a wooden wall, hand-lettered in white chalk. Title at the top: "THE GILDED LANTERN". Below it five lines, each with a price: "Honey Mead - 3 silver", "Dragonfire Stew - 5 silver", "Elven Bread - 2 silver", "Mushroom Pie - 4 silver", "Room for the Night - 10 silver". Warm candle light, anime illustration style, crisp readable lettering.

A clean flat-design infographic poster on cream paper titled "HOW TO BREW A HEALING POTION". Four numbered panels in a 2x2 grid, each with a simple icon and a caption: "1. Gather moonpetals", "2. Crush with a silver pestle", "3. Boil in spring water", "4. Cool under starlight". A footer line reads "Alchemy Guild Handbook, page 12". Teal and gold palette, crisp sans-serif lettering.
